name: Whirlpool FL DD Motor Winding Resistance (J6)
purpose: Whirlpool/Maytag 27 in. front-load direct-drive stator — all pairs at motor J6.
failureModes: Open winding — F7E2/E8/E9/EA/EC motor faults
Very low — shorted stator
testingTips: Disconnect power; test all phase pairs at J6 per W11169652 TEST #3
Locked rotor F7E9 — check drum obstruction before replacing stator

name: Whirlpool FL Inlet Valve Coil Resistance
purpose: Dual inlet valve solenoid coils — W11169652 platform.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill on that leg (F8E1)
Shorted coil — inlet valve fault
testingTips: TEST #6 fill valve; verify hot ≥120°F at tap for proper wash temp

name: Whirlpool FL Drain Pump Resistance (J11)
purpose: Drain pump winding at J11 — W11169652 TEST #8.
failureModes: Open — F9E1 long drain
Pump hums with normal ohms — impeller jam
testingTips: Check drain filter and hose height before pump replacement

name: Whirlpool FL Wash Heater Resistance (J3)
purpose: Wash/dry combo tub heater — F4E1/F4E2 heat relay faults.
failureModes: Open heater — no temp rise
Relay stuck — heater always on
testingTips: TEST #9 heating element; torque heater nut 4.5 Nm on reinstall

name: Whirlpool FL Recirculation Pump Resistance
purpose: Recirc pump motor winding on heat/steam FL variants.
failureModes: Open winding — poor wash performance, no recirc
testingTips: Verify pump turns freely before ohms test

name: Whirlpool FL Door Lock Switch — Locked (J7-1 & J7-2)
purpose: Lock switch at J7 pins 1-2 after solenoid actuates — locked = 0 Ω, unlocked = OL.
failureModes: Open while locked — F5E1/F5E2 door lock faults
Switch stuck — door state misread
testingTips: Energize lock: power on, select cycle, press START, hear click, then disconnect power before ohms
Measure at ACU side of J7 with connector removed

name: Whirlpool FL Door Lock Solenoid / Door Switch (J7-2 & J7-3)
purpose: Door switch and lock solenoid at J7 pins 2-3 with door closed — 60-90 Ω.
failureModes: Open solenoid — door will not lock
Out of range — replace door lock assembly
testingTips: Door must be closed; lock solenoid actuated before measurement
W11169652 TEST #4 chart

name: Whirlpool FL HMI 5 VDC (J19 pins 2 & 4)
purpose: HMI logic supply at ACU J19 — TEST #1 ACU power check.
failureModes: Missing 5 VDC — dead display / HMI
Low supply — intermittent UI faults
testingTips: Measure with washer powered; use needle probes on J19
Reference pin 4 (DGND) for negative lead

name: Whirlpool FL HMI 12 VDC (J19 pins 1 & 4)
purpose: HMI backlight / LCD supply at J19 — manual specifies 12 VDC (12.7 VDC limit).
failureModes: Missing 12 VDC — blank LCD in door
Low supply — dim display
testingTips: Measure with washer powered; pin 4 is DGND
If 5 V present but 12 V missing, suspect ACU supply circuit

name: Whirlpool FL Drum Light Driver (J16 pins 1 & 3)
purpose: Drum LED driver output with drum light unplugged — TEST #5.
failureModes: No voltage — ACU driver fault
Voltage present but LED dark — replace drum LED
testingTips: Unplug drum light from harness before measuring
Door open state may affect reading per manual theory

name: Whirlpool FL Water Level Sensor +5 VDC (J14 pin 2 GND, pin 3 Vcc)
purpose: APS supply at ACU J14 — TEST #7 water level sensor.
failureModes: Missing +5 VDC — sensor cannot operate; run TEST #1
5 V present with bad level reading — replace APS or clear hose
testingTips: Black probe to J14-2 (GND), red to J14-3 per manual step 12
Drain tub before replacing sensor

name: Whirlpool FL Wash NTC (J15 pins 1 & 3)
purpose: Wash temperature NTC — ~20 kΩ @ 77°F (25°C); use OEM R/T table for ambient.
failureModes: Open or short — wash temp faults / poor heat control
Good at J15 but fault persists — harness or ACU
testingTips: Begin with empty washer at ambient temperature
Compare reading to thermistor table in TEST #10

name: Whirlpool FL Dry NTC (J13 pins 1 & 3)
purpose: Dry temperature NTC — ~20 kΩ @ 77°F; combo models with vent dry.
failureModes: Open or short — dry temp faults
Good sensor, bad harness — replace main harness
testingTips: Empty washer at ambient before measuring
Use OEM R/T table in TEST #16

name: Whirlpool FL Dosing Pump (pins 1 & 3)
purpose: Bulk/optimal dosing pump coil — J10 circuit, TEST #11B / #12A.
failureModes: Open coil — no detergent dispense
Good ohms but no run — ACU or harness
testingTips: Disconnect pump connector at metering bracket
Tank must be seated in drawer for live pump test

name: Whirlpool FL Bulk Level Switch Closed (magnet present)
purpose: Level switch should close (<3 Ω) when magnet placed over sensor cavity — TEST #12B.
failureModes: Stays open with magnet — bad level sensor
Float stuck — false low level
testingTips: Open at rest with reservoir removed
Place magnet above sensor cavity while watching meter

name: Whirlpool FL Vent Fan Motor (J12)
purpose: Vent fan winding — combo dry models, TEST #13.
failureModes: Open winding — fan does not run
Good ohms — obstruction or ACU
testingTips: Check rear vent for obstruction first
Measure across fan motor terminals with harness disconnected

name: Whirlpool FL Vent Baffle Solenoid (J9)
purpose: Vent baffle wax motor / solenoid — should read less than 10 MΩ, not open.
failureModes: Open solenoid — baffle will not open
Good ohms — mechanical obstruction or ACU
testingTips: Check rear vent obstruction before electrical test
Measure across solenoid terminals with power off

name: Whirlpool FL Dry Heater 1100 W (J4)
purpose: 1100 W dry heater element — TEST #15 variant.
failureModes: Open element — no dry heat
Good at element, open at J4 — harness
testingTips: Heater is part of Heater Channel Assembly on many models
Confirm wattage variant before condemning element

name: Whirlpool FL Dry Heater 450 W (J4)
purpose: 450 W dry heater element — TEST #15 variant.
failureModes: Open element — no dry heat
Good at element, open at J4 — harness
testingTips: Dry heat may be deactivated on some models
Replace Heater Channel Assembly if element failed

name: Whirlpool FL Dry Blower Motor
purpose: Dry blower motor — 9.0–10.6 Ω; part of Heater Channel Assembly.
failureModes: Open or shorted winding — no airflow in dry
Good ohms but stuck wheel — replace assembly
testingTips: Verify blower wheel turns freely after electrical pass
Motor not separately serviceable on many models

name: Insignia Washer Level Sensor Frequency (empty tub)
purpose: WMT41WA5 frequency level sensor — F8 when <18 or >30 kHz.
failureModes: Out of band — F8 level sensor fault
TWM41 capacitive platform uses 40–50 nF instead
testingTips: Empty tub, stable power; compare to 26.70±0.3 kHz spec on WMT41

name: Samsung FlexWash Lower DD Motor (Blue-White-Red)
purpose: Lower drum BLDC stator — Blue-White, White-Red, Red-Blue pairs should be equal (~15 Ω).
failureModes: Open or unequal pairs — 3C motor/hall fault
Hall sensor disconnected — 3C with good motor ohms
testingTips: Disconnect motor connector; wire order Blue, White, Red from right
Check rotor/stator clearance for foreign material before condemning motor

name: Samsung FlexWash Main Drain Pump
purpose: Main (lower) drain pump winding — WV55M9600 service manual.
failureModes: Open winding — 5C drain fault
Normal ohms but no drain — impeller jam or clog
testingTips: Verify filter and hose before pump replacement
Bubble pump (upper) is separate: ~40–50 Ω if equipped

name: Samsung FlexWash Tub Heater
purpose: Wash heater element — ~27.1 Ω (1900 W) or ~26.2 Ω (2000 W) per manual.
failureModes: Open heater — HC1 heat fault
Thermistor ~12 kΩ at room temp should be checked with heater
testingTips: Disconnect power before ohms test
Confirm wattage variant when borderline

name: Samsung FlexWash Inlet Valve Coil
purpose: Inlet valve coil A–B — 16.05 ± 0.65 Ω per WV55 manual.
failureModes: Open coil — 4C / 4C2 fill faults
Hot/cold reversed — 4C2 on Wool/Lingerie cycles
testingTips: Verify hose orientation and house pressure before valve replacement
